desc: 孩子发烧而常规预约要等几天时，清楚说明年龄、症状和当前状态，并询问当天评估及其他就医选择。

sceneSetup.en: Aria calls a clinic because her eight-year-old son has a 39-degree fever and the next regular appointment is several days away.
sceneSetup.zh: Aria 因为八岁的儿子发烧到 39 度而致电诊所，但常规预约还要等几天。

learningGoal.en: Describe a child's current condition, ask for same-day clinical review, and confirm other care options.
learningGoal.zh: 学会说明孩子当前状态、询问当天临床评估，并确认其他可行的就医选择。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: Hi, um, my son has a fever of 39 degrees.
dialogue.zh: 你好，嗯，我儿子发烧 39 度。

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Our next regular appointment is Wednesday.
dialogue.zh: 我们下一个普通预约要到周三了。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: He's 8 and much less active than usual.
dialogue.zh: 他 8 岁，精神状态比平时差很多，不太爱动。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: Could a clinician review his symptoms today?
dialogue.zh: 今天能有医生帮忙评估一下他的症状吗？

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.zh: 发烧是什么时候开始的？

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.zh: 他现在是清醒的，也能喝水。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: Do you have any urgent slots or after hours appointments?
dialogue.zh: 你们有加急号或者门诊时间外的预约吗？

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: I'll check, but I can't promise a spot.
dialogue.zh: 我帮你查一下，但不保证一定能排上。

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: May I confirm his date of birth and your call back number?
dialogue.zh: 请问能核对一下他的出生日期和你的回电电话吗？

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: If he can't be seen here today, can I call Health 811 for advice?
dialogue.zh: 如果今天这里看不了，我可以拨打 Health811 咨询建议吗？

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.en: Yes, they can help you find the right place for care.
dialogue.zh: 可以的，他们能帮你找到合适的就诊地点。

tips.title: Could he be seen today?
tips.body: A polite way to ask whether a clinic can see a patient that day.
tips.bodyZh: 礼貌询问诊所当天能否安排患者看诊。

tips.title: the next regular appointment
tips.body: The next standard appointment available on the schedule.
tips.bodyZh: 预约表中下一个可用的普通预约。

tips.title: much less active than usual
tips.body: Describes a noticeable change from normal activity.
tips.bodyZh: 描述孩子的活动状态明显不同于平时。

tips.title: Could a clinician review his symptoms today?
tips.titleZh: 今天能请临床人员评估他的症状吗？
tips.body: A polite request for a qualified clinical review.
tips.bodyZh: 礼貌询问当天能否由临床人员进行专业评估。

tips.title: When did the fever start?
tips.body: A direct question about symptom onset.
tips.bodyZh: 直接询问症状开始的时间。

tips.title: urgent slots
tips.body: Appointment openings for more urgent concerns.
tips.bodyZh: 为较紧急情况提供的预约空位。

tips.title: after-hours appointments
tips.titleZh: 非正常门诊时间的预约
tips.body: Appointments outside a clinic's usual daytime hours.
tips.bodyZh: 诊所正常日间门诊时间之外的预约。

tips.title: I can't promise a spot.
tips.body: Staff can check but cannot guarantee availability.
tips.bodyZh: 表示可以查询，但无法保证一定有空位。

tips.title: callback number
tips.body: The phone number where clinic staff can reach you.
tips.bodyZh: 诊所工作人员之后联系你时使用的电话号码。

tips.title: find the right place for care
tips.body: Identify an appropriate place to seek care.
tips.bodyZh: 根据具体情况找到合适的就医地点。

tips.title: Describe the current condition, then ask for options
tips.titleZh: 先说明当前状态，再询问可行安排
tips.body: Share the child's age, when symptoms began, and current behaviour before asking about a same-day review, urgent slots, or after-hours care.
tips.bodyZh: 电话约诊时，可以依次说明孩子的年龄、症状何时开始以及现在的精神和饮水状态，再询问当天评估、紧急名额或非正常时段的安排。

tips.title: Use the scene for language practice
tips.body: This scene practises communication and does not replace medical advice. Follow local emergency guidance if a child appears seriously unwell.
tips.bodyZh: 本场景用于语言练习，不能替代医疗建议。如果孩子情况严重，请遵循当地紧急医疗指引。
